stackStats.enabled.description: Collect local coding sessions. Pause Tracking disables collection across windows.

stackStats.includeProjectNames.description: Include workspace folder display names in future activity metadata. Existing history is not rewritten.

stackStats.collectFilesystem.description: Observe filesystem changes in eligible workspaces automatically, with no setup: coalesced notification counts plus local-only reconciled external-change records (open-document reloads supply diff lines). The writer stays unknown unless a connected agent reports it. External changes never count as coding time.

stackStats.collectGit.description: Poll Git metadata at most once per minute in trusted workspaces. Never read commit messages, authors or remotes.

stackStats.collectWorkflows.description: Observe VS Code task and debug lifecycles. Never read commands, arguments, output or debug configuration.

stackStats.collectDiagnostics.description: Observe severity counts on diagnostic changes. Messages and code snippets are not collected.

stackStats.allowAttributionReports.description: Allow cooperating extensions to report provenance for existing edit batches. Reports are claims, not verified authorship.

stackStats.agentIntegrations.claudeCode.description: Managed by Connect / Disconnect in the Stack Stats Agents view (Stack Stats: Manage Agent Integrations). While on, Stack Stats accepts signals from its Claude Code hook: agent runs and agent-reported file changes as metadata only, with no prompts, responses, commands or file contents. Turning this off pauses labeling without removing the hook; Disconnect removes it. Local only; never synced. Agent time never counts as coding time.
stackStats.agentIntegrations.claudeCode.markdownDescription: Managed by **Connect / Disconnect** in the Stack Stats **Agents** view ([Manage Agent Integrations](command:stackStats.manageAgentIntegrations)); you normally never change this directly. While on, Stack Stats accepts signals from its Claude Code hook: agent runs and agent-reported file changes as metadata only, with no prompts, responses, commands or file contents. Turning this off pauses labeling without removing the hook; **Disconnect** removes it. Local only; never synced. Agent time never counts as coding time.

While on, Stack Stats accepts signals from its Codex hook: agent runs and agent-reported file changes as metadata only, with no prompts, responses, commands or file contents. Turning this off pauses labeling without removing the hook; **Disconnect** removes it. Local only; never synced. Agent time never counts as coding time.

stackStats.excludeFiles.description: Additional excluded file globs (*, ** and ?). Applied before all collectors and session tracking. Built-in secret/generated-file exclusions always apply.

stackStats.excludeProjects.description: Exclude workspace/repository roots by full-path or folder-name glob. Existing history is retained.

stackStats.rawRetentionDays.description: At startup, remove local telemetry batches delivered more than this many days ago. 0 retains indefinitely. Undelivered telemetry, session history and daemon SQLite are preserved.

stackStats.syncHourlyActivity.description: Include private UTC hourly activity aggregates when Profile Sync is enabled and the server supports the richer contract. This can reveal work schedules. Public sharing remains a separate choice. Disabling queues replacements without hourly data; existing server data changes only after successful sync.

stackStats.showStatusBar.description: Show Stack Stats in the status bar. Hiding it does not pause tracking.

stackStats.inactivityTimeoutMinutes.description: End the current session after this many minutes without edits. Changes apply immediately and may close an idle session. This does not change the 60-second active-time evidence gap.

scripts.build: esbuild src/extension.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:vscode --outfile=dist/extension.cjs && esbuild src/agent-hook.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/agent-hook.cjs && esbuild src/uninstall.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/uninstall.cjs
